top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a continuous discovery chain (Holst on the incretin effect and GLP-1 secretion, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology, Mojsov on the active truncated peptide) whose therapeutic consequences are confirmed in large independent randomized trials. Originality, mechanistic clarity and maturity are secure and the citation scope is defensible. The attribution risk (Habener priority, Knudsen's acylated analogues left out) is real but does not outweigh the case for awarding; no award is ranked second.
